title: Geffen Theme
description: Adds Ragnarok Online's Geffen Theme as a playable and craftable Music Disc to the game
body:
# Geffen Theme - Music Disc
# 
Bring the atmosphere of Geffen to your Minecraft world! This mod adds a high-quality custom music disc featuring "SoundTeMP - Geffen Theme" 
Features:

    Custom Music: A fully functional music disc that works in any standard Jukebox.
    Vanilla+ Feel: Designed to blend seamlessly into your inventory and creative tabs.
    High Fidelity: Uses high-quality audio compression to ensure the track sounds great in-game.

## How to Obtain ##

You can craft the disc in a crafting table using:

X G X\
G T G\
X G X

X = nothing
G = Gold Ingot
T = Redstone Torch

Recipe unlocks automatically in your recipe book once you pick up a Gold Ingot!

 
## Credits: ##

    Music: SoundTEMP - Geffen Theme

    Requires Fabric API.
